cases: function-based pool reuse and independent relocation

contract: Functions may mutate explicit regional inputs and invoke function memory overloads.
Dynamic reads/writes, perform/behave and selected procedure calls remain rejected.
Aliasing, cross-region field restrictions and regional reference provenance remain enforced.
Ordinary functions use mutable-state semantics; const-function is a future separate design.
limits: Typed make, ordinary region owners and owning/borrowed whole-region argument/result types remain unimplemented pending their source contract.
Mailbox send is permitted by the language direction for explicit arguments, but no native transport is implemented.
Plain type still denotes bits products in this prototype; region-only user type migration remains outstanding.
No const-function mode or automatic read-only snapshot guarantee is provided.
Post-relocation pool reuse is performed by the independent C++ checker, not resumed CoD code.
